additional_info.subject: RE: ID0473030-DC/Si-UC/FR-[Y2 / R9 313202799123] SECC Initialization Error CRM:03055000531
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Shcoepff,
I am reaching out form the Technical Support Team in regards of ticket
ID0473030.
The ticket was opened for vendorErrorCode "secc is initializing" on charger
Y2/R9 313202799123.
First of all, it is important to know that this error is not a bug, but a "normal" error message that states that the EcoG is initializing after a communication outage with the charger.
I had a look at the logs and the charger, and here is what I found:
The real issue happened two days before, on 2026-01-16, when outlet 1 when outoforder to due a communication outage between the PLC and the EcoG:
Because of this, the outlet status on Sifinity was set as "Faulted/Unavailable"
Unfortunately, there was a problem on the outlet status detection on Sifinity:
The outlet status on Sifinity was not updated to "Available" once the outage finished
The outlet status remained on "Faulted/Unavailable"
On 2026-01-18T22:11:31, the connection to OCPP Backend went offline for 30 seconds. It was automatically restored thanks to the websocket ping interval of 30 seconds.
Once the charger went back online on OCPP Backend, it communicated the status of the outlets, including the "wrong" status of outlet DC1, which for Sifinity was still "Faulted/Unavailable"
Corrective actions:
I asked R&D and they acted on the syncing between SCB and Sifinity to solve the outlet status visualization. It is now solved ad the outlets are correctly seen as Available.
The vendorErrorCode "secc is initializing" is a correct error message that appears after a loss of communication with EcoG.
In regards of the loss of communication and "outlet is offline", R&D and EcoG are working on hardening patches to avoid this behavior to happen again in the future. These communication hardening patches will be included in the next FW release v9.0.X (expected release: CW10)
Please let me know if further analysis or support is required, otherwise I will proceed to close the ticket as no further action is pending on service side.
Looking forward to hearing feedback from you.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer
